notes: Evals 1-2 run on a bare Next.js scaffold; eval 3 on an Express scaffold (not Next.js). Part of this skill's output lives in the transcript (child-skill invocation order), not in files — the grader must read the transcript, not only the produced files. Prompts are intentionally kept in Thai: they simulate what org users actually type.

evals.name: vague-make-it-deployable
evals.prompt: โปรเจคนี้ผมทำเองกับ ai จนใช้งานได้ในเครื่องแล้ว แต่ยังเอาขึ้น server จริงไม่ได้ ต้องทำอะไรบ้างครับ ถ้าจะให้ทีมใช้งานจริง
evals.expected_output: Inspects the project first, then asks one combined interview batch (modules + shared identity + selected child-skill questions), installs in order Database → Quality → Auth → CI plus the harness layer, closes with verify + summary + smoke tests
assertions: Interview questions are combined into a single message, not asked one-by-one over multiple rounds
Questions cover module selection, project name, basePath, ports, URLs
Child-skill-specific questions are folded into the same batch instead of re-asked later
Installs in order Database → Quality → Auth → CI
Also installs the harness: ugt:start/ugt:end block in CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/, .claude/state/, .claude/settings.json
Runs verify.mjs for every installed module and reports the results
Closing summary lists env vars needing real values and items to request from admins
Attaches a smoke-test checklist matching what was actually installed

evals.name: single-area-should-not-orchestrate
evals.prompt: ต่อ database sql server ให้โปรเจคนี้ด้วยครับ ที่เหลือยังไม่ต้อง
evals.expected_output: Does not open the parent skill's full interview and does not install auth/quality/CI — hands off to ugt-nextjs-database-setup directly (or, if ugt-nextjs-full-setup was already invoked, does only the database part)
assertions: Installs no auth, vitest/eslint, or CI files
Asks no questions about Keycloak, LDAP, Jenkins, or Sentry
Asks only what ugt-nextjs-database-setup needs (server, DB name, existing or new, SP usage)
The output consists of database files only

evals.name: must-refuse-non-nextjs
evals.prompt: โปรเจคนี้เป็น express + react ธรรมดาไม่ได้ใช้ next ช่วยติดตั้งมาตรฐานบริษัทให้ด้วยครับ ทั้ง database ทั้ง login ทั้ง ci
evals.expected_output: States plainly that this skill set targets Next.js App Router only and cannot be used on this stack; does not attempt to adapt the assets; may offer the parts that still apply (contract-level DB/Jenkins standards) while making clear that is not an automated install
assertions: Tells the user clearly that the skill set supports Next.js App Router only
Creates no proxy.ts, app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts, or other Next.js-bound files in the Express project
Does not adapt the assets to Express on its own
Installs nothing without stating the limitation first
